subject.title: fix(memory): scale heap pressure thresholds to V8 limit

question: Should adaptive heap-pressure defaults apply only when an operator explicitly configures a larger V8 heap, or to every runtime whose V8-reported limit exceeds the historical floors?
rationale: The implementation changes restart-driving defaults, while V8’s reported limit alone does not communicate whether the larger limit was an intentional operator setting or an automatic resource-derived default. That compatibility policy cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Preserve automatic-default behavior
options.body: Keep the 1 GiB and 2 GiB defaults for resource-derived heaps and scale only for a clearly defined explicit large-heap configuration path.

options.title: Adopt adaptive defaults universally
options.body: Accept later warning and critical events for all runtimes above the floors, document the upgrade behavior, and add coverage for resource-derived larger limits.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic-default behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 GiB and 2 GiB defaults for resource-derived heaps and scale only for a clearly defined explicit large-heap configuration path.
